sn48.8:1.1: This discourse offers brief expansions of each of the five faculties in terms of standard doctrinal groups of four. This complements the definitions in the next discourses. | The same analysis is applied to the five powers at [an5.15]().
sn48.8:1.5: Faith in the Buddha, Dhamma, Sangha, and unshakeable ethics ([sn12.41](), [sn55.1]()). | By this means “ethics” are included in the faculties although not explicitly mentioned. We have noted the same thing for the awakening factors ([sn46.1]()) and mindfulness meditations ([sn47.3]()).
sn48.8:1.14: As usual, _samādhi_ (“immersion”) is defined in terms of _jhāna_ (“absorption”; see [sn53.1-12]()).
